_doc: The new-game intro (ADR-0064): cards played in order by IntroPlayer. kind: caption (a stamp line and typed lines on black), document (a typed paper form with a rubber stamp), radio (a transcript, line by line), title (the game's name and where you are). hold: seconds the card stays once fully shown. sound: played when the card starts (UI bus). {day} {time} {sector} are filled from the session.

cards.stamp: CORVANE DEEP MINE  ·  SAWBACK RANGE  ·  EIGHTEEN MONTHS AGO
lines: Bore Nine broke into a cave older than the mountains.
What came up was pale, fine as hair, and it wanted nerves.
Its hosts lose themselves but keep walking. The Hollowed.
By day they stumble half-blind. At night they hunt.
The ground hums.
And every Hollowed for miles comes for the brightest fire it can hear.

cards.heading: NOTICE OF QUARANTINE
lines: The Hollowmere valley is closed.
Fence, drones, a burned firebreak: the Cordon.
No one comes out who has not been cleared.
A few hundred residents fled to the high timber. Do not approach them.

cards.heading: REMAND SALVAGE PROGRAM — ENROLMENT
lines: Salvager No. 4471.
Duty: recover Bloom core samples and field-lab records from inside the Cordon.
Each delivery to Waystation 9 shortens your sentence.
The tether on your wrist stays locked. It will tell you when the ground is due to hum.

cards.heading: CORDON CONTROL  ·  CH 4  ·  05:52
lines: LIFT 3|Control, Lift Three, over the firebreak. One package for Larch Hollow.
CONTROL|Copy, Three. Wind light from the west. Drop and climb.
LIFT 3|Ground's moving down there. Trees shaking, no wind —
CONTROL|Three, say again?
LIFT 3|Winch let go early. Package is down. Package is down hard.
CONTROL|...Log it. Waystation 9 out.
You come to on cold ground with the tether ticking against your wrist.
{hum_in}
The valley breathes on the seventh night.
